title: Menu
description: The navigation menu every user sees. Each entry can require a permission: users only see what they may open, and a group without visible entries is hidden.

actions.addChild: Add an entry to this group

list.empty: The menu is empty: create its first entry.
list.emptyGroup: Empty group: it is not shown until it has entries.
list.dragHint: Drag the handle (or focus it and use the arrow keys) to reorder. To move an entry into another group, edit it.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: The menu of a user with the checked permissions.

form.description: Links open a page of the app (/…) or an external site (https://…). Groups hold links.

url.label: URL
url.required: The URL is required for a link

form.groupHint: A group is shown only to users who can see at least one of its entries.
form.linkHint: The page itself must still check the permission: the menu only hides the entry.

errors.url: Use a path starting with / or an http(s):// URL
errors.icon: Pick an icon from the list
errors.unknownPermission: That permission does not exist in the API
errors.iconMustBeKebabCase: Pick an icon from the list
errors.urlMustBePathOrHttp: Use a path starting with / or an http(s):// URL
errors.parentMustBeTopLevel: Groups can only be at the top level
errors.groupCannotBeNested: A group with entries cannot go inside another group
errors.entryInGroupNeedsUrl: An entry inside a group must be a link
errors.cannotBeItsOwnParent: An entry cannot be its own group

delete.title: Delete "{{label}}"?
delete.message: It disappears from every user's menu.

alerts.error: The change could not be saved
alerts.loadError: The menu could not be loaded
